svg.text: Start with one strong agent and add more only when a measured benefit (parallel work,

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: focused context) beats the coordination cost. Choose an orchestration pattern, a way to

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: communicate, and coordination tools like task ledgers and worktrees, and expect

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: failures from poor design and weak verification.

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 先做一个强的单智能体，只有当可衡量的收益（并行、聚焦上下文）大于协调成本时才增加智能体。选

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 好编排模式、沟通方式和协调工具（任务账本、工作树），并预料到设计不当和验证不足带来的失败。
